title: CyberPower OR2200PFCRT2U 2000VA PFC Sinewave UPS (Certified Refurbished)

writeup: Woot has the CyberPower OR2200PFCRT2U, a 2000VA pure sine wave PFC UPS in a 2U rack/tower design with 8 outlets, certified refurbished for $329.99. B&H Photo and Newegg both sell it new for $740.95, so this is about 55% less, a $410.96 saving. Only 1 was left when we checked, with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B003OJAHW0 matched to model OR2200PFCRT2U, UPC 649532609598 by the verified checker.
